jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - AI Research & Reliability
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. M.Sc. or Ph.D. in an exact science field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics) with deep academic or applied background in NLP or Machine Learning 5+ years of industry experience in data science or machine learning, with a proven track record of taking complex AI/NLP solutions from concept to large-scale production Deep expertise in modern AI architectures, specifically advanced RAG, LLM fine-tuning, agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), and robust LLM evaluation methodologies

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer- for Adi Davidovic's team
